1.consolidated_definition: Árbol silvestre de hasta 20 m de altura, con tronco maderable, hojas gruesas, elípticas, pecioladas, flores verdosas en grupos axilares y bayas ovoides sostenidas por el cáliz de la flor; su madera es usada en construcciones. (Lauraceae; Ocotea leucoxylon).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild tree of up to 20 m in height, with a timberable trunk, thick, elliptical leaves with petioles, greenish flowers in axillary groups and ovoid berries supported by the calyx of the flower; its wood is used in constructions. (Lauraceae; Ocotea leucoxylon).
